They join more than 25 services you can already connect, like… The post Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: You can now connect eight more services to Copilot using GitHub-verified MCP servers, or connectors, available in public preview. They join more than 25 services you can already connect, like Slack, Figma, and Sentry.
takeaways: VS Code : Open the Agents window, go to Customizations , and connect the service you want. github.com : Browse services on the Copilot customization page and select the service you want.
Copilot CLI : Run /mcp , switch to the Connectors tab, and select Connect on the service you want.
With Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise, an admin needs to enable the Editor preview features policy.
